title: Just Juice Below Zero Blackcurrant Honeydew Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Below Zero Blackcurrant Honeydew offers a refreshing and fruity profile that balances deep berry notes with tropical sweetness. The blend opens with the rich, slightly tannic taste of ripe Blackcurrant, which is immediately lifted by the lighter, aromatic flavour of Honeydew Melon. A distinct icy finish wraps around the fruit notes on the exhale, providing a crisp and cooling sensation that enhances the juiciness of the melon and berry combination. This e-liquid is supplied as a Saltfill, containing 40ml of concentrated fragrance in a 60ml bottle. This format leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 60ml of e-liquid at your preferred strength. Unlike standard shortfills, this blend features a 60PG/40VG ratio, making it perfectly suited for low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) devices and pod kits. The higher PG content ensures efficient wicking and delivers a sharp, clear flavour profile with discreet vapour production. Part of the Below Zero collection, this range by Just Juice focuses on delivering vibrant fruit flavours with a signature frozen edge. The Saltfill format is designed to offer the cost-effectiveness of a larger bottle while maintaining the high-PG consistency required for smaller starter devices. We recommend mixing this liquid with nicotine salt shots to maintain the smooth throat hit intended by the mixologists.
